question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept below G. Only two boxes are kept between G and B. Only A is kept above F. E is kept at some place below D and at some place above C. How many boxes are kept above E?
solution:
Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only three boxes are kept below G.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between G and B.
 
• Only A is kept above F. E is kept at some place below D and at some place above C

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
